:::{#sol-hyperplane-origin-practice}

Setting $x_2 = 0$ gives $x_1 = 2$, so $\vx_0 = (2, 0)$ is in $\mathcal{H}$.
With $\vec{w} = (2, 1)$, take $\vecf{v} = (-1, 2)$.
Then $\vx_0 + t\,\vecf{v} = (2 - t, 2t)$, and

$$
2\,(2 - t) + 2t - 4 = 0
$$

for every $t$.
Conversely, a point $(x_1, x_2)$ of $\mathcal{H}$ has $x_2 = 4 - 2 x_1$,
so it is $\vx_0 + t\,\vecf{v}$ with $t = 2 - x_1$.

:::
